subject.title: ACP parent session stuck until refresh when yielded waiting for child completion

question: Should yielded-parent resumption become one core runtime contract across ACP and native subagents, or should maintainers land only the current narrow recovery slices and keep broader behavior issue-by-issue?
rationale: The remaining behavior crosses ACP relay, native subagent announce delivery, task registry fallback, heartbeat wake, and channel routing; automation cannot safely choose whether to add a formal shared yield-wait/resume contract or continue landing narrower mitigations.

options.title: Define One Core Wake Contract
options.body: Treat this issue as the canonical contract and require candidate fixes to compose into heartbeat-independent yielded-parent resumption across ACP and native subagents.

options.title: Land Narrow Slices Only
options.body: Accept open candidate PRs as incremental mitigations and leave remaining ACP/native edge cases to narrower follow-up issues.

options.title: Document Current Limits
options.body: Reject dedicated yield-wait semantics for now and document heartbeat/polling limitations as current behavior.

recommendation.title: Define One Core Wake Contract
recommendation.body: Treat this issue as the canonical contract and require candidate fixes to compose into heartbeat-independent yielded-parent resumption across ACP and native subagents.

likelyOwner.reason: He merged recent native completion-delivery work and is the clearest routing owner for the cross-runtime session-delivery decision among the history candidates.
